what_it_is.prose: Kalyani Strategic Systems Ltd (KSSL) is the defence arm of the Kalyani Group, wholly-owned by Bharat Forge Ltd (founded 19 June 1961 by Nilkanthrao A. Kalyani, Pune). KSSL is a leading Indian private-sector artillery OEM with a portfolio of 155mm/52 calibre gun systems. Key products: (1) MArG 155-BR / MArG 52 — world's smallest 155mm/52 calibre mounted gun system, weighing 24 tons on a Kalyani 4x4 vehicle, introduced in 2026 and unveiled at Eurosatory 2026 (June 2026) with patented Soft Recoil Technology (SRT); (2) Bharat-52 — 155mm/52 calibre towed howitzer (potential frontrunner for Indian Army's 400-towed-gun TGS tender worth ₹6,500 Cr, March 2025); (3) ATAGS (Advanced Towed Artillery Gun System) — 155mm/52 calibre towed howitzer developed with DRDO; KSSL bagged India's largest domestic artillery contract — order for 184 ATAGS (Asian Military Review, June 2026); (4) First howitzer export order worth $155 million (November 2022) — India's first artillery export order. KSSL partnered with US AM General LLC (June 2026) to offer distinct mounted artillery gun systems for world armies. Kalyani Rafael Advanced Systems (KRAS) — 51:49 JV between KSSL and Israel's Rafael Advanced Defense Systems — produces Spike anti-tank guided missile (ATGM) parts and missile systems: opened manufacturing facility 3 August 2017; $100M order from Israeli defence firm (July 2019); ₹287.51 crore missile systems order (August 2023).
